bio: Sit back and relax in luxury with Afternoon Tea in Ludlow. Sip tea and taste dainty sandwiches at Fishmore Hall, a lovely recently restored country house that has been transformed into a relaxing boutique-style hotel in the heart of the midlands.  Afternoon Tea is served in the stylish restaurant, which is beautifully furnished and very much in keeping with the Georgian origins of the house. Waiters and waitresses will serve your sweet and savoury goodies at your table.
